title: A Domain-specific adaptation network for elliptic interface problems
summary: Deep learning provides a flexible mesh-free framework for solving elliptic interface problems. However, domain-specific neural approaches often rely on separate networks for individual subdomains, causing the model complexity to grow rapidly as the number of subdomains increases. To address this limitation, we propose a Domain-Specific Adaptation Network (DSAN), which combines a shared backbone with lightweight subdomain-specific adapters to provide local represen- representation flexibility without replicating a complete network for each subdomain.
